about.text: A sour-milk cheese of skimmed cow's milk, soured by lactic acid without rennet, then salted and ripened. It is sold fresh and crumbly, or ripened to a semi-hard cheese with a yellow rind; it is made in eastern Switzerland, Liechtenstein and the Montafon in Austria, and protected since 2010.
